model: nano_banana_pro (Nano Banana Pro; the jobs report nano_banana_2)
description: The Emperor's / Empress's regalia (outfit 'emperor', unlocked by holding all three cities and both great ports). Inspired by the user's photo of a masked figure in white embroidered robes - no crosses or religious signs, only arabesques, laurel and stars. Painted on flat #FF00FF (the robes are white, so the white-paper cutout could not be used): keyed with the colour distance to the painted magenta, the soft edge unmixed, the background RGB filled with the nearest figure colour, cropped tight, LANCZOS to 900 px tall like the royal robes. Drawn at body height EMPEROR_BODY_H = 52 (game.js).
